outcome: ICU admission due to respiratory distress
cohort: The study included antenatal women after 20 weeks of gestation and women up to 6 weeks postpartum who experienced respiratory distress and required intensive care unit admission.
finding: The majority of obstetric women admitted to ICU for respiratory distress were 21-30 years old, multiparous, from a rural background, and respiratory distress predominantly occurred in the antenatal period, with obstetrical causes (61.47%) like pre-eclampsia and eclampsia being more common than non-obstetrical causes (38.52%) such as sepsis and respiratory disease.
cross-section timing: Admissions of women after 20 weeks of gestation and up to 6 weeks postpartum.
